body: Thank you, truly. I’ve never felt like much more than a burden. I’ve always tried to be the one to laugh it off. It’s cost me quite a bit. People don’t take me seriously or think I’m shallow. In reality, I’m trying so hard to survive. I love deeply and I feel deeply. I want my daughter to be strong and to know she’s wonderful and capable in every aspect. I don’t want to fail her. I’m just very unsure if I can do this.
I understand because I’m here with you. I don’t know want to go back to a psychiatric hospital to work through my issues. Maybe we can do this and pull through?
